claim_text: Exquemelin's 1678 first edition presents the burning of Panama as an action carried out by English and French buccaneers.

claim_scope.limitation: Verification establishes what the 1678 source attests; it does not by itself prove every detail of the event or actor responsibility.

source.repository: Library of Congress, Jay I. Kislak Collection
source.author: A. O. Exquemelin
source.title: De Americaensche Zee-Roovers

controlled_transcription: Het derde 't verbranden van de stadt Panama, door d'Engelsche en Franse rovers gedaen
source_says: Part III presents the burning of Panama as carried out by English and French buccaneers.

genealogy.assessment: The 1678 Dutch edition is the earliest cited edition. The 1679 German and 1684 English editions are translations/derivatives and must not be counted as independent source chains.

corroboration.assessment: Derivative translations preserve the same source tradition but are not independent corroboration. This gold candidate is deliberately scoped to the source attestation itself.

contradiction_search.note: A human reviewer must deliberately assess contradiction status before final VERIFY.

provenance_note: Public LoC catalogue and exhibition surfaces establish edition identity and expose the title-page statement. HISTORICAL_GOLD remains blocked until a human explicitly inspects the facsimile and signs the review and final verification records.
